properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RC4 is used for encryption in several parts of the codebase, particularly in MuPDF's cryptographic handling (fitz/crypt-arc4.c) and libarchive. RC4 is broken independently of quantum computing and should be replaced with AES-256-GCM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 is used for hashing in several parts of the codebase. It's collision-broken regardless of quantum computing and should be replaced with SHA-384.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-ECB mode is used in libarchive for several key sizes (128, 192, 256 bits). ECB mode is fundamentally insecure because identical plaintext blocks result in identical ciphertext blocks, which can leak information about the plaintext. Should be replaced with AES-GCM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Certificate hostname verification is disabled in ext/mupdf/platform/x11/curl_stream.c. This allows any valid certificate to be accepted, making the application vulnerable to MITM attacks. Should be enabled for secure communication.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Non-constant-time comparison (using == operator) is used in 156 locations across various cryptographic libraries. This can lead to timing side-channel attacks that leak information about the data being compared.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 is used in libarchive with iteration counts below the OWASP minimum of 600,000. This makes password-based key derivation vulnerable to brute-force attacks and should be increased.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA-2048 is used in test certificate generation (tests/pki.ts, tests/pki-chain.ts). While this is only in test code, it demonstrates the use of quantum-vulnerable RSA encryption. The tests create self-signed certificates using RSA key pairs, which would be vulnerable to quantum attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Static IV/nonce is used in 4 locations. This reuse under one key breaks CTR/GCM catastrophically and should be replaced with dynamically generated values.
